ops.title: macOS fileproviderd can ack a domain add but defer actual creation ~85 min; remove-acks during the stall are no-ops, resurrecting orphan domains — fixed fusekit v0.35.0 + cc-pool v0.49.0
ops.body:
2026-07-08 acct-14 incident (full forensics: ccn doc e07ab97). On macOS 26.5, fileproviderd acked `NSFileProviderManager.add` (domain listed) but processed the `domainCreation` **85 minutes later** — 42 min after `ccp add` gave up. Existing domains stayed healthy; only new-domain creation stalled. The app-side remove no-ops ok:true on a not-yet-listed domain and a timed-out add is never cancelled, so rollback "success" still yielded an orphan domain (CloudStorage dir + appex, no accounts row).

Key rules:
- Registration ack ≠ creation; remove-ack under stall ≠ removal. Only reconciliation closes the orphan race: `ccp doctor` detects, `--fix` removes (predicate evaluated at scan AND re-confirmed adjacent to removal).
- The only unbounded call in the old Setup chain was `open -g` (launchApp) — probable sink for the unexplained ~34 min. fusekit v0.35.0 bounds it (30s, `LaunchTimeout` knob) and adds per-phase elapsed to Setup errors so future timeouts self-attribute.
- fusekit `RemoveConfirmed`: stable absence (3 consecutive ErrNoDomain) + one re-Remove + `ErrDomainRemovalUnconfirmed` joined with the last error — but an hours-deferred creation still wins; doctor is the backstop.

Related: [[fp-backend-rollout]], [[claude-pool-project]], [[fp-migrate-storm-incident]].
